country.evidence_quote: Welcome to the Australian Motoring Enthusiast Party (AMEP). We are a registered Australian political and community party representing the interests of motoring enthusiasts — the drivers, riders, restorers, club members and family motorists whose passion has built and sustained Australian motoring culture for more than a century.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: We work closely with the AAA and others to campaign for better roads. Motorists well and truly pay their fair share of taxes and charges and we expect that this money is put back into roads.
